name: UI：视频上传节点-字段配置验证(上传类型+变量引用+字符限制)
description: 验证视频上传节点的3个配置字段完整性(上传类型Select/商品ID/视频URL)、字符数限制探测

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter(el => el.textContent.trim() === '打开'); if(btns.length > 0) { btns[0].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no open btn'; })()

return (() => { const modals = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal'); for (const m of modals) { if (m.classList.contains('ant-modal-hidden')) continue; const r = m.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width < 200) continue; const cards = m.querySelectorAll('.ant-card-hoverable, .ant-card'); for (const card of cards) { const t = card.querySelector('.ant-card-meta-title'); if (t && t.textContent.trim() === '视频上传') { card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); card.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待视频上传编辑抽屉加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const text = drawer.textContent || ''; const fields = ['上传类型', '商品ID', '视频']; const fieldFound = fields.filter(f => text.includes(f)); const inputs = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]), textarea')); const selects = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-select')); const textareas = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('textarea')); return { open: true, fieldCount: fieldFound.length, fields: fieldFound, inputCount: inputs.length, selectCount: selects.length, textareaCount: textareas.length, fullText: text.substring(0, 1000) }; })()
steps.description: 分析视频上传节点表单结构

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const labels = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-label, label')); const fieldMap = {}; for (const label of labels) { const text = (label.textContent || '').trim(); if (text.includes('上传类型')) fieldMap.uploadType = true; if (text.includes('商品ID') || text.includes('商品')) fieldMap.itemId = true; if (text.includes('视频') && !text.includes('上传')) fieldMap.video = true; } return fieldMap; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const selects = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-select')); const selectLabels = selects.map(s => { const label = s.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label'); return label ? (label.textContent || '').trim() : 'no-label'; }); const hasUploadTypeSelect = selectLabels.some(l => l.includes('上传类型')); return { selectCount: selects.length, selectLabels, hasUploadTypeSelect }; })()

steps.label: video_upload-config
steps.description: 视频上传节点字段配置截图

steps.expression: return (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden) .ant-drawer-close'); if(c) c.click(); return 'closed'; })()

_testDesign.realDomNotes: 视频上传节点配置字段: 上传类型(Select,主图视频)/商品ID(Input)/视频(Input)；共3个字段，无标题/文案/达人账号
riskPoints: 上传类型Select是否包含其他视频选项(如主图视频/详情视频)
商品ID字段是否支持变量引用(需有上游节点才可见)
视频字段是否支持URL直接输入
